plan.summary: BRO-5340: Lloyd Evans's Spectator review of Harry Potter and the Cursed Child (publishDate 2016-08-06, the original two-part Palace Theatre premiere that opened 2016-07-30) sits on the 2026 one-part entry, whose priorRuns declares that run inheritReviews:false. BRO-5333 stops that window from exempting the review, so the next rebuild flags it on the one-part entry. The original-run entry has no Spectator review, so move it there.

actions.description: Review published 2016-08-06 is of the 2016 two-part premiere; the one-part production began previews 2026-10-09.
